applicability.description: Reconcile two pre-parsed record sets (sources A and B) under a schema-agnostic field map: matches keys, classifies as equal/missing/conflicts/unreconcilable. Operates on in-memory JSON dicts, not raw CSV/JSONL.
requires_markers: records.a and/or records.b as list of dicts
claims: T0: deterministic classification given fixed inputs and field_map
T1: deterministic reconciliation across multiple key fields and arbitrary field paths via dot notation

limitations: No nested array reconciliation (object-of-arrays not supported)
No type coercion beyond numeric vs string normalization
No fuzzy/approximate key matching (exact equality only)
Match keys must be non-null in both sources to be reconcilable
Date/time fields normalized as strings (no timezone normalization)
